title: LLMbrane configuration
description: Configuration for the LLMbrane LLM gateway and multiplexer. String values support environment variable interpolation via ${VAR}.

aliases.description: Maps a public model name to a 'provider/model' target, optionally with per-alias overrides.

unknown_fields.description: How to handle requests containing unknown fields.

unsupported_features.description: How to handle requests requiring capabilities the resolved endpoint does not support.

providers.description: Provider definitions, keyed by provider name (used in aliases as 'provider/model').

alias.description: Alias definition: either a shorthand target string ('provider/model') or a mapping with a target and optional overrides.

default_reasoning_effort.description: Canonical reasoning effort applied when the client request omits reasoning_effort. Takes precedence over the target model's default_reasoning_effort. An explicit client value (including "none") always wins.

debug_dir.description: Directory for file-based debug logging (disabled if omitted).

debug_retention.description: How long to keep debug log files.

retry.description: Provider-side HTTP 429 retry behavior. Unset fields keep the built-in defaults (6 retries, 1s base delay, 250ms jitter, 60s max delay).

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries after an initial HTTP 429 response (0 disables retries).

base_delay.description: Base backoff delay before the first retry. Without a provider Retry-After header the delay doubles per attempt.

jitter.description: Maximum random jitter added to each retry delay.

max_delay.description: Upper bound for a single retry delay. If the computed delay exceeds it, the provider's 429 is returned to the client instead of retrying.

provider.description: A provider groups one or more endpoints.

api.description: API shape of the endpoint. Determines which outbound adapter is used.

url.description: Endpoint URL. May contain '{target_model}' as a placeholder (e.g. Bedrock).

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers, e.g. API keys via ${ENV_VAR}.

models.description: Models exposed through this endpoint, keyed by the public model name.

capabilities.description: Capabilities supported by this endpoint (union with per-model capabilities).

extensions.description: Adapter-specific settings. Known keys depend on the 'api' shape.

reasoning_effort_mapping.description: Maps canonical reasoning effort levels to provider-specific values. Supported by: openai-chat-completions, openai-responses, anthropic-messages (canonical values only).

thinking_mode.description: Anthropic outbound thinking mode: adaptive (default) uses output_config.effort; budget uses legacy thinking.budget_tokens.

inject_thought_signature_bypass.description: Bypass for thought-signature injection. Supported by: openai-chat-completions.

omit_params.description: Request parameters to drop for models that do not support them. Supported by: openai-responses.

aws_access_key_id.description: AWS access key ID (use ${ENV_VAR}). Supported by: bedrock-converse.

aws_secret_access_key.description: AWS secret access key (use ${ENV_VAR}). Supported by: bedrock-converse.

aws_session_token.description: Optional AWS session token (use ${ENV_VAR}). Supported by: bedrock-converse.

rate_limit.description: Optional local TPM queue. Active only if tokens_per_minute > 0 or the provider returns a supported token-limit header.

tokens_per_minute.description: Token budget per minute (0 = rely on provider headers only).

utilization.description: Fraction of the token budget to use (0..1).

queue_timeout.description: Max time a request may wait in the queue.

output_reservation_tokens.description: Tokens reserved for the response when admitting a request.

modelConf.description: Mapping of a public model name to an upstream model.

target.description: Upstream model ID sent to the provider.

capabilities.description: Capabilities supported for this model (union with endpoint capabilities).

default_reasoning_effort.description: Canonical reasoning effort applied when the client request omits reasoning_effort. An explicit client value (including "none") always wins. When unset, no reasoning configuration is sent and the provider default applies.
